title: Choose the Deep Dive That Fixes a Real Gap
description: Your notification baseline works at normal load, but an estimate shows 2,000 messages/s arriving and only 1,500/s draining. A delivery-age goal matters. What is the strongest next discussion?

options.text: Calculate unrelated profile storage without connecting it to a choice.
options.explanation: That arithmetic does not address the demonstrated queue deficit or delivery-age goal.

options.text: Rename diagram components to more advanced technologies.
options.explanation: Names alone do not change the rates or explain a capacity tradeoff.

options.text: Stop because the happy-path request already works.
options.explanation: The baseline exposes the next problem; sustained backlog prevents meeting the agreed delivery target.

options.text: Explain the 500/s deficit, compare capacity and admission options, and choose a queue-age alert.
options.explanation: This ties the estimate to a requirement-driven deep dive, states the tradeoff and closes the loop with an operational check.
